core_meaning.primary_meaning: Golrokh is a Persian-origin name meaning “Rose-faced”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Golrokh corresponds to the Persian form گلرخ (Persian گلرخ (golrokh) 'rose-faced', from گل + رخ 'face'). Its core sense is rose-faced, of rose countenance. Golrokh is the Persian گلرخ (golrokh) — گل 'flower' + رخ 'face, countenance' — 'rose-faced, of rose countenance'. The source gave the meaningless غُلرُخ and mislabelled it 'Arabic' while glossing it 'rose garden'; both were corrected.
